headword: {濃口醤油|こいくちしょうゆ}
gloss: dark soy sauce; regular soy sauce

definitions.gloss: dark soy sauce; regular soy sauce
definitions.explanation: The standard, dark-colored soy sauce, which makes up most soy sauce sold in Japan. Plain {醤油|しょうゆ} usually means this kind. It is darker in color but lower in salt than the light {薄口醤油|うすくちしょうゆ} of the Kansai region.

examples.japanese: {濃口醤油|こいくちしょうゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{足|た}す→足す：01168_tasu⟧。
examples.english: Add a little dark soy sauce.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃口醤油|こいくちしょうゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Dark soy sauce is widely used in the Kanto region.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃口醤油|こいくちしょうゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}く→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: You can make this recipe with dark soy sauce too, but the color will be darker.

notes:
⟦{濃口|こいくち}→濃口：27553_koikuchi⟧ (strong, dark type) + ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce). Mostly a word for recipes and labels; in everyday talk this is simply ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薄口醤油|うすくちしょうゆ}: light-colored soy sauce, saltier, used in Kansai cooking to keep the food's color
- ⟦たまり{醤油|じょうゆ}→たまり醤油：27593_tamarijouyu⟧: thick, rich tamari soy sauce from the Chubu region
- {減塩醤油|げんえんしょうゆ}: low-salt soy sauce
